s04ED83.name: Replace event tile and draw 2x2 stripe
summary: Overworld event: finds the layer 1 tile at the current event position in DATA_04DA1D, writes the matching replacement tile (DATA_04DA33) into the map at $7E:C800 and queues two stripe records (2x2 tiles) for the new graphic.
Second routine at $04EE30: draws a layer 2 event tile run and terminates the stripe buffer. Details of the $1DEA/$1DEB tables are inferred.

s04EE7A.name: Table: 2x2 tile blocks for event drawing
summary: Six blocks of four words (TL, BL, TR, BR); indexed by [$13D0] * 8 in CODE_04EEAA.

s04EEAA.name: Draw event tile blocks into stripe image
summary: Queues 2x2 tile blocks from the table at $04EE7A as stripe records, one block per row, depending on the event step [$13D0] and event [$13D1]. Jumps back into CODE_04ED83 at $04EDE6 to write the last block.

s04EF3E.name: Unused. Padding ($FF fill)
summary: Filler bytes.

s04F280.name: Table: ! block particle X speeds
summary: Eight X speeds for the switch palace block particles, signed.

s04F290.name: Switch palace ! block particles
summary: Overworld effect after a switch palace is completed ([$13D2] non-zero): spawns batches of eight ! block particles around the player, moves them (X, Y, height with gravity) and draws them as OAM tile $E6.
$04F397: advance one position axis of one particle and convert it to a screen coordinate.
$04F3E5: state dispatcher for the overworld two-player lives exchange screen ([$1B87]).
Parameters: [$1439] phase, [$1437] timer, [RAM_KeyHolePos1/2] reused as particle count and OAM offset.

Ptrs04F3EA.name: Pointer table: lives exchange states
summary: Eight state routines for the lives exchange screen, indexed by [$1B87] - 1.

s04F411.name: Table: iris window step and target
summary: Two bytes each: step per frame (+4/-4) and target radius ($68/$00).

s04F415.name: Lives exchange: iris window effect
summary: Closes/opens a circular window on the overworld around the screen centre, one step per frame, and advances [$1B87] when the target radius is reached.
State 7 shows the CONTINUE AND SAVE stripe image. Also selects the player with more lives.

s04F499.name: Stripe image: blank rows
summary: Used as an image pointer in bank 0 (RLE blank fill of BG3 rows).

s04F4B2.name: Stripe image: MARIO/LUIGI lives screen
summary: Template copied to the stripe buffer: names, lives text, blank cursor slots and marker tiles.

s04F503.name: Table: lives cursor tiles
summary: Four 4-byte tile sets for the selection cursor.

s04F513.name: Lives exchange: input and drawing
summary: Handles the two-player lives screen: Start continues, the other buttons choose a player and give one life to the other player (cap 98), then draws the player names, lives and blinking cursor.

s04F625.name: Table: overworld sprite init data
summary: Five bytes per entry, read backwards by CODE_04F675.

s04F64C.name: Table: overworld sprite init data
summary: Continuation of the overworld sprite init table.

s04F665.name: Table: overworld sprite warm-up counts
summary: Number of times to run the sprite routine for each extra slot.

s04F675.name: Initialise overworld sprites
summary: Called when loading the title screen. Fills 13 overworld sprite slots from the table at $04F616 and runs the main routine for slots $0D-$0F to warm them up.
Interpretation is partial.

s04F6D0.name: Tables: sprite spawn offsets
summary: Eight values for $0E55 and 16-bit X and Y offsets relative to the screen, used by the sprite code at $04F770.

s04F6E8.name: Table: sprite spawn Y offsets
summary: 16-bit Y offsets relative to the screen.

s04F6F8.name: Tables: sprite timers and values
summary: Timer reload values and index values used by the code at $04F708.
